message:
classes take their template from the decorator, not a file:
      libs/components/widget/src/badge.ts: PctWidgetBadge
$reason: The template under a quoted key, `'template':`, its text kept in a constant. ngc names a property by a string as it names one by an identifier, and compiles the constant into `consts` (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker; the class in `package.json` carries the declaration ngc writes). The pattern that stood at point 1 wanted `template:` and read no template here, and with the text out of the decorator's body the counter over the body had nothing to count: the part reached the package read alone, and point 2 named the class as one the scanner does not see. Written in the body, the same template was refused by that counter, for the wrong cause.
